name: hud_ui_mgr_switch_active_dialog
description: HudUiMgr::SwitchActiveDialog swaps the active HUD layout dialog, deactivates the previous layout, activates the new layout, and restores HUD enabled state when switching while active.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x413660 validates reading the previous g_HudUiMgr.enabled state, calling DisableHud only when previously enabled, setting layoutDelayFrames to 2 when previously disabled, deactivating the old current layout when present, activating the new layout, storing it as current, and calling EnableHud only when the HUD was previously enabled.

The native smoke verifies the disabled switch path sets layout delay and swaps active layouts without requiring HUD disable/enable, and verifies the enabled switch path calls the disable/enable helpers, deactivates old layout, activates new layout, stores the new current layout, leaves the HUD enabled, and refreshes alternate clip source state.
